cast.name: Creator
cast.description: Indian woman, early thirties, curly black hair, lavender satin pajamas; calm, sincere, diary-style creator voice, mid-pitch female

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: I started tracking the dark spots that made my skin look uneven, and this became the most important part of my night routine.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: The texture is rich and creamy, not watery or stringy.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: I massage it in until my skin absorbs everything.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Kojic Acid, Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin help reduce the appearance of dark spots.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: I use it consistently every night.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Two weeks later, my spots look reduced and my skin looks naturally brighter.
